subtitle: Skin Health Tracking
description:
Glowlytics is your personal skin health companion -- a clinically inspired tracking app that turns your daily skincare routine into measurable progress.

POWERED BY INTELLIGENT ANALYSIS
Glowlytics combines advanced computer vision with dermatology-inspired scoring frameworks (GAGS for acne, SCORAD for inflammation, VISIA-inspired metrics for sun damage) to give you objective, repeatable skin assessments. No guesswork, no subjective before-and-afters -- just data.

DAILY TRACKING THAT TAKES SECONDS
Snap a photo each morning. Our guided camera overlay ensures consistent lighting and framing so every scan is comparable. The app measures inflammation, pigmentation, and texture indices, then translates them into five intuitive signal scores: Structure, Hydration, Inflammation, Sun Damage, and Elasticity.

SEE YOUR SKIN STORY UNFOLD
Watch trend lines evolve over days, weeks, and months. Interactive charts show how each signal responds to product changes, sunscreen adherence, sleep quality, and hormonal cycles. Animated gauges and sparkline tiles make complex data instantly readable.

PERSONALIZED PRODUCT INTELLIGENCE
Scan any product barcode or search by name. Glowlytics cross-references 45+ active ingredients against your skin profile and current concerns to generate a personalized effectiveness score. Know exactly which products are working -- and which ones are not worth the shelf space.

CLINICIAN-READY REPORTS
Generate professional PDF exports that summarize your trend data, representative photos, product history, and context overlays (sunscreen use, sleep, cycle tracking) into a format your dermatologist can actually use. Bridge the gap between daily self-care and clinical conversations.

SMART ONBOARDING
Tell Glowlytics your age range, primary concern, and target scan region. The app tailors its scoring weights, recommendations, and product intelligence to your specific goals -- whether that is clearing acne, reversing sun damage, or monitoring skin aging.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Glowlytics stores scan history locally and uses encrypted backend services when needed to sync account data and generate non-diagnostic skin insights. We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or train public models on your photos.

BUILT FOR REAL PEOPLE
- Deterministic scoring algorithms (no random fluctuation)
- Works offline after initial setup
- Supports secure email authentication
- Warm, low-contrast interface designed for comfortable morning routines
- Haptic feedback for a premium, tactile experience
- Accessibility-conscious design with clear contrast ratios

WHAT YOU GET
- Unlimited daily skin scans with guided camera
- 5 signal dimensions with animated trend visualizations
- Barcode-based product scanning with ingredient analysis
- Personalized product effectiveness scores
- Clinician-ready report generation with representative photos
- Sunscreen adherence tracking
- Optional sleep and cycle context integration
- Streak tracking to build consistent habits

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Glow Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Privacy Policy: https://glowlytics.ai/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Glowlytics was built by a team focused on helping people track skin changes more consistently and discuss trends more clearly with their clinician. Download today and start understanding your skin like never before.

demoAccount._note: Live demo-account password is NOT committed to the repo; enter it directly in the App Store Connect review-notes field. Rotate periodically and keep the demo account rate/spend-capped so it cannot incur unbounded paid API spend.

reviewNotes.notes: Sign in with the demo account email above; the password is supplied in the App Store Connect review notes (not committed to source control). The app auto-loads 21 days of skin scan history, 4 products, and gamification data for this account so all features are immediately visible. Key flows to review: (1) Home screen with score tiles and trend sparklines, (2) Camera tab for guided skin scan, (3) AI processing disclosure shown before the first facial skin scan, identifying the data sent to OpenAI and requiring permission before upload, (4) Signal detail pages with animated gauges and source citations, (5) Products tab with ingredient analysis, (6) Profile with streak and badges, (7) Profile > Account & Plan > Delete account for full account deletion. The app uses OpenAI for vision analysis only after consent. Data sent can include the captured scan photo, skin-analysis scores, recent scan context, skin goals, and limited HealthKit summaries if the user connected Health. OpenAI does not receive live face-mesh alignment data. The reported random sign-out issue is addressed by holding routing until Clerk and local store hydration complete, preserving Clerk's token/resource cache, and applying backend JWT clock tolerance. The reported 'See the evidence' issue is addressed: the Day story evidence CTA now opens the pattern evidence detail screen, and signal/recommendation screens show source citations. The app requires camera access for skin scanning. HealthKit integration is optional and can be skipped during onboarding. Subscription disclosures and legal links appear on the paywall screen.
